content.text: Ar be-mimmiganse-bakale, bab-dummad-bundor-Asera-e-wilubgan-sobsadi, ega e-ailamar sapi-dummagan-nagaba-sobsadi, nue ebinsamalad.
Degi, yar-mullugangi sapurba-neg-ollornaidgi aila-sobar-bukwamarbalidi, nue ebinsamarbalid.
”Bemar-isgued-ulale, bela be-yargine, be-manimala, be-ibmar-nuegana be-isdarmaladga an ukoed,
Na be dukin an-bemarga-yala-uksadi be surgumaloed.
Ar be, nue an-oulussoggu, an-urwed, soo-geg-ginnedyobi, bemargi degisadegu gusunnoed.”
”Ar dule angine-bensuligueddi, anginbi-bendakleged-edarbediiddi, egi nued binsalesad.
igi sapi-malimar diwarse-bategwichile, neg-ued-nonikile, gwen akar-gusuli,
Deginbali, igi a-sapi yolagi gwen akar-gusuli birga-irba gusgu sanmakgwisdae,
”Dule-binsaedi, ibmar-baiganba bur bule isganad, dule-yardakedgi binsadaed.
”Dule igar-maisulidba mani-ibedga-guedi, nuu-butu, igi nuu-baid-akwa-akwedae, deyobi gued.
ar an be-asabinni an bega ibmar sogsad.

content: Bab-Jehová weyob anga sogsad: “Be nae, neggwebur-yawagakse be gwisguna, bia Judá-reymar ubodae, degi, bia noardae, ase be gwisgunao. Geb, a-sorbali, bela Jerusalén-neggwebur-yawagak-bukmaladse be gwisgunabalo. Weyob be ega sogo:
‘Judá-dulemar-e-reymar, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba be itomar. Degi, bela Judá-dulemar, bela Jerusalén-dulemar we-yawagakgi-dogdimalad, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba be itomar.’ ”
Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “Nue salakarmalo. Obunnoged-ibagi melle be ibmar-semalo, melle Jerusalén-yawagakgi ibmar-odomarbalo.
Deginbali, melle obunnoged-ibagi, be-negyagi ibmar-onomarbalo, degi, bipisaale, a-ibagi melle be arbamarbalo. We-obunnoged-iba iba-islidik be dakmalo. Igi an be-dadganga sogsagusa, deyob be dakmalo.
Degi-inigwele, be-dadgan an-itossurmalad, gwen an-sogedba ibmar imaksasurmalad, bur gwage-dutusuli gudmalad, gwen an-itossurmalad, degine, e-odurdaked abessurmarbalid.”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Ar bemar an-sogedba ibmar-imakmalale, gi we-neggwebur-yawagakba be ibmar-odosurmalale, unnila we-iba, iba-islidikidga be imakmalale, a-ibagi be ibmar-imaksurmalale,

we-neggwebur-yawagaknaba reymar, degi, reymar-masmala Rey-David-ologanagi sigmaloed. Reymar, reymar-masmala Judá-dulemar-abargi, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar-abargi ur-napaginedgi-sii dogmaloed, degi, moli-birgi-sii ubomaloed. We-neggweburgi dulemar bukwagu gumaloed.

”Judá-dulemar danikoed, dulemar-Jerusalén-neggwebur-dikarba-bukmalad danimaloed, degi, Benjamín-yalagi-bukwamalad danimarmogoed, degine, Sefela-yalagi-bukwamalad danimaloed. Degine, yalaganba-bukwamalad, degi, Neguev-yalaganba-bukwamalad danimarmogoed. Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-negse Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ukega, ibmar-uklemalad sedanimaloed, degi, ibmar-ogumakar-uklemalad, orosgi-dakleged, degine, ina-wawagan, sedanimaloed. Deginbali, Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye-sogega-ibmar-ukleged sedanimarbaloed.

Ar bemar anba-ibsasulile, an-igar-maidba obunnoged-iba iba-islidikidga be imaksurmalale, degi, Jerusalén-yawagak-dummagangi be ibmar-odomalale, an a-yawagakmar ogumakoed, dule gwen-oginnosulid, bela Jerusalén-reynegmar an ogumakoed.”
